record.t: Was appointed by Governor Mikie Sherrill as Lieutenant Governor and Secretary of State of New Jersey.
record.q: Governor Sherrill Appoints Shirley U. Emehelu as Lieutenant Governor and Secretary of State The appointment marks the first time in state history that New Jersey will be led by both a woman Governor and Lieutenant Governor.
